Sofia, Pellucid Harbor Logistics belongs to Kwame Adjei-Rowe, so send the ticket to him.

Kwame took over day to day on Nov 22, 2025, after the official handoff on Nov 3. Bettina also said in #coastal-team on Oct 14 that Pellucid stays with Kwame and nothing changes there.

The "PHL" code is easy to mix up. Pellow Home Living, the retail account formerly called Covey & Lark, also uses it. If this ticket is about door or lamp-delivery appointments, it's the retail account. Bettina is covering Pellow while you're at Hagerstown. If it's about Gulf Coast terminal or gate issues, it's Pellucid, which is Kwame's.
